text: I rarely buy apps. LifeUp however is worth every penny. No sneaky monthly costs or paywall features. Just a one-off with good value for money if you want to gamify your life. Whether you like themes or not. The level of customization lets it up to your imagination. Sure, they can improve. Especially on instructions and translation. Also, setting up can be a hassle. It would save time if you could simply copy and edit someone else's configuration: a complete set of tasks, items, achievements, etc
author: Patricia Hinse

text: Love the app. I've downloaded many icons from icons8 to customize it even further. Please add support for custom attributes showing on profile!
author: Shanti Naharani
developer_reply: Thank you for liking our app! However, due to our server resources and auditing requirements, we may have difficulty exposing custom properties for the time being. But in the future, we will develop more UI (like widgets) and statistics about attributes and open APIs for querying attributes.

author: Mandy van Doorn
developer_reply: Thanks for your review! Glad you like the app. LifeUp still has a lot of future development plans. If you have any further feedback, please feel free to let us know by email at kei.ayagi@gmail.com.

text: Great app, if you like to gamify your live without fantasy elements. I like the option to earn points with taks and using them tot buy rewards. It is just what I need to stay motivated.
